title: Nusa Penida vs Gili Islands: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Nusa Penida for dramatic scenery, manta ray diving, and photography. Gili Islands for beach relaxation, nightlife, and beginner diving. Do both with 10+ days.

categories.name: Scenic Drama
categories.summary: Kelingking Beach, Diamond Beach, and Broken Beach offer some of Southeast Asia’s most dramatic coastal scenery.

categories.name: Diving
categories.summary: Manta rays at Manta Bay and mola mola at Crystal Bay make Nusa Penida a world-class dive destination.

categories.name: Beach Relaxation
categories.summary: Calm, swimmable waters and white sand beaches. No cars on the islands.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Daily costs are lower on the Gilis once you factor in Nusa Penida’s mandatory driver fee.

categories.name: Accessibility from Bali
categories.summary: 45-minute boat from Sanur vs 2–3 hours for the Gilis.

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: Gili Trawangan has a well-developed restaurant and bar scene. Nusa Penida is basic warungs.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: Gili T is one of Southeast Asia’s party islands. Nusa Penida has almost no nightlife.

categories.name: Getting Around
categories.summary: No cars or motorbikes on the Gilis — walk, cycle, or cidomo. Nusa Penida requires a mandatory driver.

categories.name: Best Time to Visit
categories.summary: April–October is peak for both, but manta ray season (July–October) makes Nusa Penida a must during dry season.

categories.name: Accommodation
categories.summary: Three distinct islands with wide range of options from hostels to boutique resorts.

faq.question: Is Nusa Penida or Gili Islands better for first-time visitors?
faq.answer: Nusa Penida for dramatic scenery and manta rays; Gili Islands for beach relaxation and ease of access.

faq.question: Which has better diving?
faq.answer: Nusa Penida wins for advanced diving and manta rays. Gili Islands wins for beginner-friendly diving and sea turtles.

faq.question: How do you get there from Bali?
faq.answer: Nusa Penida: 45-min boat from Sanur (IDR 200-250K). Gili Islands: 2-3 hour boat from Padang Bai (IDR 500-800K).
